title: Anchorite
pitch: A hermit chained to a huge anchor: one object is your only weapon, your grapple, and your burden.
howto: Hurl the anchor to crush foes — where it embeds, you're tethered to it. Reel yourself in, swing on the taut chain, slam it down from above, or yank it back through the horde. Bank relics to forge longer chains, stronger hurls, and greater anchors.
controls: Drag to aim, release to hurl. Buttons: move, jump, HURL/REEL, SLAM/YANK. Keyboard A/D + Space + J/K. Gamepad supported.
